text:
Lena: Heads-up  Beta customer Corvus wants a documented path for private deploy upgrades: goal is <1h maintenance, in-region, plus a mandatory HSM key rotation and audit export. They asked for choices they can pick in console.
Owen: Two patterns make sense: 1) Rapid operator swap (45-60m) where we drain, upgrade, swap IPs. 2) Operator blue/green with tenant cutovers: longer wall time but near-zero tenant downtime.
Priya: For regulated customers the HSM rotation step is the long pole. Auditors request signed approval + full rotation artifact export. That normally adds hours.
Marco: Mitigation idea: pre-provision the rotated key objects and pre-run the signing/audit steps in staging. During the maintenance window we only perform the final bind/unbind. That reduces active ops to minutes.
NetOps: We will only conduct BGP/peering flips if: (a) there's a validated runbook, (b) automated rollback triggers exist, and (c) a paid "managed cutover" engagement is selected. Otherwise the customer must perform the peering change.
Lena: Product proposal: show a new toggle on the upgrade flow: "Managed cutover (Redwood runs routing)" with an inline price uplift and required preflight checks. If toggle is on, console must block the scheduling until preflight passes.
Owen: Engineering: we need explicit rollback heuristics (e.g., 5% error-rate increase OR 99p latency > X ms). Also an emergency revert API that SRE can call during the window. Expose a visible "Revert" button in the console for owners.
Priya: Legal needs to approve liability language for Redwood-managed routing. Also require HSM customers to submit a signed approver name and a staging dry-run artifact before production windows.
Marco: UX: add a short checklist panel showing preflight gates. If any gate fails, show remediation steps and an estimated time to fix. Example gates: IP reserved, DNS resolves, KMS pre-staged, operator health OK, model pin locked, KV cache >= 90%.
OpsBot: preflight command: /preflight-run <customer-id>. Available checks: ip-reserved, dns-resolution, kms-prestaged, operator-health, model-pin, kv-cache-percent.
NetOps: We'll publish a one-pager runbook and a small verification script customers can run to produce an AS-path proof and ACL snapshot. Link will be included in the console.
Lena: Pricing note: managed cutover should be a line item with an SLA summary (target downtime, credits if we fail). Product to own copy and uplift amount.
Owen: For side-by-side tenant migrations we must export tenant routing state and model sequence lock snapshots to enable quick rollback if needed. Add that to engineering acceptance criteria.
Priya: For HSM rotations require: staging dry-run passed, audit export present, named approver, and audit artifacts uploaded to the order. Block managed cutover until artifacts are validated.
Marco: Ops: add a preflight gating flow that prevents booking managed cutover if preflight status != pass. OpsBot to surface failing checks and allow re-run.
OpsBot: Note created: private-upgrade-1767111111. Reminder scheduled: tomorrow 08:00 PT -> /preflight-run 1767111111.
Lena: Action items: Lena draft console copy & checkbox language; Owen spec revert API + rollback thresholds; Marco produce preflight checklist and tenant-state export plan; NetOps publish runbook + script; Priya draft legal consent + HSM acceptance criteria; OpsBot implement preflight gating.
Owen: +1
Priya: +1
Marco: On it
